'''Amis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] student who attended the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Amis-Academy.png|thumb|left|200px|Amis in class in the Academy]]
Amis was one of the cadets of the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]],<ref name="The Academy" /> one of the brightest students groomed for leadership for the next generation of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<nowiki/>t.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|characters|amis|Amis}}</ref> Alongside with [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and some of his friends, he helped in the discovery of the source of corruption in the [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] government. After being instructed by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on the dangers of corruption in government, Amis and his friends, led by [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie]], went to explore the warehouse containing the food rations. While there they discovered a black market deal and recorded it. Soon after they were discovered and escaped. After accidentally revealing to Tano what they had done, they went to [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] in the hopes she could discover and stop what was going on. However, after telling she would handle it, she warned them not to get involved. This prompted the cadets to contact [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] and inform him of the evidence.<ref name="The Academy" />

Unknown to the children, Almec was the one behind the black market deals, and attempted to capture the children had it not been for the intervention of Tano. After she analyzed the hologram revealing Almec's involvement, the children with Tano attempted to warn Satine, who had already been captured. After Tano handed over the students under the guise as [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], she attempted to discover Satine's location. After Tano was captured, the children were brought to the Satine in the hopes Almec could use them to get Satine to sign a confession of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. However, Tano and the children managed to stop Almec and aided in his capture and removal from Mandalore's government.<ref name="The Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref>

<div style="float:right">[[File:CadetsAllGrownUp-TL.png|thumb|left|220px|Amis and his friends breaking Duchess Satine out of prison]]</div>
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] took over Mandalore under the leadership of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Amis assisted [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] and the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]] in rescuing Satine, who had been imprisoned in the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]]. Amis flew a [[Balutar-class swoop/Legends|''Balutar''-class swoop]] to escort the Duchess as they were pursued by [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]]. They were able to get Satine out of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] so that she could send send a message for help to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Unfortunately, Satine was recaptured, but Amis and the other students managed to escape the Mandalorian super commandos during the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|Battle of Sundari]].<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Personality==
As a [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]] cadet, Amis was the wise-cracker amongst his friends, a good-spirited student who often thought with his stomach.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amis was portrayed by voice actor [[Omid Abtahi]].<ref name="The Academy" />
